Coverage breakdowns and rotations · 2023

Fourth-down decisions

Head coaches graded on every fourth down outside the final two minutes of each half: the win probability after going for it, kicking or punting, compared with the call they made. A spot is "clear go" when going adds 1.5 or more points of win probability.

League: went for it when going was clearly better

How to read it

Win probability lost per game adds up the gap between the best option and the call made. Small model errors push every coach's number up a little, so compare coaches with each other rather than reading the totals as exact. Early-season samples are small.
